name: south arch building over Armenian Patriarchate Rd (roof over the road)

notes.replaces: OSM w1394456881 (building=roof; removed in the profile, see manual_buildings m_s01_armenian_1).
notes.height: cornice ~11 m (pediment apex ~13 m) from the 2.2 m door in 01 and the R6-scaled bollards; the pediment, archivolt and keystone are requested in the profile (with the passage carved this footprint is only two 0.9 m strips beside the vault).
notes.facades: the passage walls (22, 04): ashlar with small bellied grilled windows, a narrow round-arched doorway with a dark door, iron lantern brackets (wall_lantern stand-ins).
